exact_statement: Let f_(k,l)=1-2*1_A on r=2k+l uniform bits, where A consists of 0, every unit vector, and k disjoint matched weight-two points. For every such function and every physical restriction, every relevant coordinate satisfies B_i<=K6 Inf_i, K6=16/3-(21/8)log2(3)+(95/24)log2(5)-(121/24)log2(11)+(65/24)log2(13). This constant is sharp for both min_i B_i/Inf_i and B/I over this hereditary class, with equality only at the six-variable perfect matching core up to cube symmetries, output sign and dummies. Perfect matching roots have E->2 and H/I->4. Every physical stopping tree on the class satisfies H(f)<=E H(leaf)+(K6+2/ln2)(I(f)-E I(leaf)). For arbitrary simple graph-edge extensions on n>4 bits, E<=2+8/(n-4)+(n^2+n+2)(2n+3/2)/2^n, which is below 368/125 for n>=16. Padded monotone paths of length m<=n have E bounded by the maximum of 2+2(n+1)(2n+3/2)/2^n and 2+4/(n-1)+2(2n+3/2)/((n-1)2^n) in nonconstant n>=2 cases, which is below 368/125 for n>=10. The graph/path statements are root bounds, not universal descendant payment.
